findings.current: Morgoth understood that all too well. It could only fascinate and astonish him.
findings.defect: “Understood that” makes Morgoth seem to understand why people sacrifice themselves for friends, contradicting the preceding sentence.
findings.rationale: He knows that people make those choices but cannot understand their reasons.
findings.replacement: Morgoth knew all too well that they did such things. Why they did so remained a source of fascination and astonishment to him.
findings.source: 그 사실을 너무나도 잘 알고 있는 모르고스로서는 그저 흥미롭고 놀라울 따름이었다

findings.current: swallowed and erased by the distant roar
findings.defect: “Distant” makes the roar sound far away rather than overwhelming the screams.
findings.rationale: The screams are lost beneath the immense noise of the collision.
findings.replacement: swallowed and erased by the deafening roar

findings.current: Ash drifted down over his slender frame.
findings.defect: The ash moves down Morgoth’s body, not down onto it.
findings.rationale: 신형을 타고 흘러내리는 describes ash running along his figure.
findings.replacement: Ash slid down his slender frame.

findings.current: “Yeah. A damn arrogant, thoroughly treacherous human. But…”
findings.defect: “Treacherous” implies betrayal that 간악 does not specify.
findings.rationale: 간악 characterizes him as wicked or devious without alleging that he betrayed anyone.
findings.replacement: “Yeah. An arrogant, downright devious human. But…”
findings.source: 그래. 아주 시건방지고, 간악하기 짝이 없는 인간이지. 하지만…….

summary: One contradiction in Morgoth’s understanding of friendship, plus three localized fidelity issues.
